items.title: Here's what happened in crypto today
items.summary: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.

items.title: Bitcoin falls to four-month low near $62K as crypto selloff deepens
items.summary: The global cryptocurrency market capitalization fell 4% to $2.26 trillion over 24 hours, while Ether and Solana posted double-digit weekly losses.

items.title: Coinone warns of phishing, identity theft after customer data breach
items.summary: The South Korean crypto exchange said potentially exposed information includes passwords, bank account numbers, national identification numbers and crypto wallet addresses.

items.title: RWA protocol stUSDT winds down three years after $2.3B TVL peak
items.summary: The stUSDT team did not disclose a reason for winding down the RWA protocol but assured holders that all underlying assets remain fully backed.

items.title: Microsoft confirms global outage resolved, rules out cyberattack
items.summary: Microsoft attributed the outage to a network capacity upgrade issue, confirming that the disruption was unrelated to cyberattacks or AI agents.

items.title: MegaETH parent cuts 20% of staff amid restructuring, AI push
items.summary: MegaETH co-founder Shuyao Kong said the restructuring affected employees who helped build the project's blockchain, wallet and ecosystem.

items.title: The Week Jensen Huang Fell: How a Spy Scandal Toppled Nvidia's CEO
items.summary: In a matter of days, the executive synonymous with the AI boom resigned after 33 years amid reports of affairs and suspected Chinese intelligence ties-sending Nvidia's stock reeling and leaving the chipmaker leaderless.

items.title: OpenAI, Anthropic, Google and Other AI Giants Face Lawsuit Demanding Development Freeze
items.summary: Four nonprofit advocacy groups want a California court to stop major AI developers from building stronger models, alleging their technology could cause catastrophic harm worldwide.

items.title: What Is Canton Network? The Privacy Blockchain Built for Wall Street
items.summary: Canton Network is a privacy-enabled blockchain built for banks and tokenized assets. Here's how it works and what Canton Coin (CC) does.

items.title: OpenAI Launches ChatGPT Wallet to Let AI Agents Shop-Without Crypto
items.summary: OpenAI's new wallet lets AI agents buy products using ordinary cards, challenging crypto payment tools from Coinbase and Circle as companies compete to control everyday online shopping by autonomous software.

items.title: Could a Former Nvidia Executive Replace Jensen Huang? Arm's Rene Haas Emerges as Candidate
items.summary: Nvidia's board has reportedly approached Arm's chief executive as it searches for a replacement for Jensen Huang, while some employees are pushing to bring the chipmaker's founder back as CEO.

items.title: Should Government Officials Be Banned From Prediction Markets? House Oversight Says Maybe
items.summary: A House Oversight staff memorandum, citing suspicious trades by officials, military personnel and clearance holders, recommends Congress weigh new limits on federal personnel betting on platforms like Kalshi and Polymarket.

items.title: Kava Lend loses roughly $3.8 million to hack, sending KAVA token down nearly 40%
items.summary: About 49.2 million KAVA was bridged to BNB Chain via LayerZero and sold for roughly $2.1 million in BNB and USDT.

items.title: Louisiana AG calls CFTC chair an 'obsequious standard bearer' for prediction markets following agency lawsuit
items.summary: The CFTC sued Louisiana Friday to block a state judge's order banning 31 prediction markets, including Kalshi and Polymarket, in the state.

items.title: Bitcoin ETFs lose $1 billion for the second week in a row as crypto funds, except one, continue bleeding
items.summary: U.S. spot crypto ETFs lost about $1.55 billion combined, and Avalanche funds' $227,000 was the only weekly inflow among the 15 categories SoSoValue tracks.
